zh: 自定义工具导入小窗支持在导入成功后自动关闭，并保持操作失败时的友好提示。
新增内置工具「考勤验收」，支持考勤明细与验收评分编辑、工作日自动计算及格式化 Excel 导出。
优化夜间操作激励统计工具黑名单季度月均扣减与分摊计算，完善表格布局与异常样式。
en: Custom tool import dialog now automatically closes upon successful import while keeping error messages visible on failure.
Added bundled "Attendance Acceptance" tool for managing attendance logs, evaluations, and formatted Excel exports.
Refined night operation incentive calculator with improved quarterly average deduction logic, table layout, and anomaly styling.
